subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Against the clock

options.text: To take on a task that is a way to big

solution:
The correct answer is** ****'****Rushed and short on time'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The given idiom **"Against the clock" **refers to being in a hurry or having very little time to complete something (समय सीमा के खिलाफ) 
 
• The correct meaning of this idiom is **"Rushed and short on time,"** reflecting the sense of urgency (समय की कमी होना) 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is-* 'Rushed and short on time'.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• **To take on a task that is way too big:** Accepting a task beyond one's capacity (बड़ा काम संभालना)
 
• **On the point of achievement:** Close to achieving something (उपलब्धि के बिंदु पर)
 
• **To avoid talking: **Deliberately avoiding conversation (बात चीत से बचना)

1ca:T7c0,
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**</
